observations.title: Fuxi: The Ghost in the Shell?
claims_checked: This repository is not the agent's source tree at all -- it contains no Go (or any agent) implementation. The repo itself owns three things: the public docs/marketing site (README.md, docs/usage.md),
Entirely delegated / absent from this repo. A `find` over all 206 files shows zero Go source files (despite the README claiming 'Built in Go') and the only *.py files are throwaway benchmark fixtures

Nearly every functional claim is unverifiable because no implementation ships in the repo: 'self-contained ... Built in Go' (README.md:12-15) cannot be checked against any Go source, since none exists

benchmark/REPORT.md is the most technically interesting file, not for cleverness but for what it reveals under scrutiny: it presents itself as 'Real Client Environment Verification' with real CLI outp
